before: What it buys: +3 on both trap skills on a build whose Open Lock is Dexterity-based and under-ranked, +3 Reflex against traps, and 5 more metres of ranged sneak-attack range from the core, which a bow uses on every life. Where the 4 AP come from is the player’s choice; the two last purchases in the Action points by level table, Thrill of the Hunt 2 at level 17 and Know Your Foe (or Harper Training I) at 20, are the ones with the least in them, and leaving them unbought keeps every gate in the four main trees met (Deepwood 15 is still 12 under tier 3). Bought early, from level 4 or 5, the four points sit in Mechanic for the whole heroic run and are reset into the last two picks at 20 if the trap gear by then makes them unnecessary. Three more points (Awareness 1 and Skill Boost, tier 2, 5 AP spent) add +3 Search and a +6 Action Boost to all skills for 20 seconds; that is the step past this one if the DCs still fail.
after:
What it buys: +3 on both trap skills on a build whose Open Lock is Dexterity-based and under-ranked, +3 Reflex against traps, and 5 more metres of ranged sneak-attack range from the core, which a bow uses on every life. Buy Arbalester (core 1) for 1 AP first, then Mechanics ranks 1–3 for 1 AP each: 4 AP total, available from Rogue level 1 when funded.

Funding and timing (build decision). Either optional package needs AP actually available or reallocated at the time of each purchase, while preserving all affected prerequisites and gates. Taking the 4-AP option at level 4 or 5 requires AP already earned by then, reallocating existing purchases only if needed and preserving all purchase gates. Omitting future purchases at levels 17 or 20 does not supply earlier AP, and a later reset only returns points at that later time. The published Action points by level schedule remains unchanged; this note does not establish an alternate level-by-level allocation.

Optional extension: 7 AP total, only on a life already at Rogue level 2 or higher. After the 4-AP package, buy tier-1 Awareness rank 1 for 1 AP: its printed bonus is +1 Listen, Search and Spot, bringing Mechanic to 5 AP spent. Then buy the single rank of tier-2 Skill Boost for 2 AP: activate it to gain a separate +6 Action Boost bonus to all skills for 20 seconds (30-second cooldown), for 7 AP total. Tier 2 requires both Rogue level 2 and 5 AP already spent in Mechanic before purchasing Skill Boost. A character still at Rogue level 1 cannot buy this extension merely by spending more AP. The selected class split is unchanged.

Awareness overlap. Only the highest Awareness bonus from the different trees applies. Mechanic Awareness rank 1 does not add to a higher Awareness already owned, so it does not improve those skills while the selected Arcane Archer Awareness 3 is trained. Skill Boost is the separate active effect described above. Sources: Mechanic enhancements and Enhancements; 8 November source receipt and limits.
